text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Visiting the disaster-stricken area, 
Transcend was warmly welcomed by the 
locals who were striving to reclaim their 
daily lives.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When asked if she was suffering 
unnecessarily by worrying too much about 
them, Transcend realized she had closed 
her heart off and come to a standstill.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To answer the calls of fans wishing to see 
her shine on the track again, Transcend 
fired up her motivation for the Mile 
Championship Nambu Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though the venue was Tokyo, her running 
figure would reach everyone and give them 
courage. In tandem with the revival of the 
North, Transcend began taking slow strides 
once again.
